faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before ordering.

items.q: Which cities do you deliver to?
items.a: We cover Rabat, Salé, Témara, Kénitra and their surroundings. For any other destination, message us on WhatsApp — we always find a solution.

items.q: How much does a delivery cost?
items.a: The price depends on the distance and the type of ride. Send us the details on WhatsApp and get an instant quote, no commitment.

items.q: How fast is my order delivered?
items.a: On average, a courier picks up your order within 15 minutes and delivers it in under an hour depending on the distance.
Cash on delivery or bank transfer. Simple, with no surprises.
Yes! You receive a real-time tracking link as soon as the courier takes over your order.
